issues.description: The problem statement says the DDNode.successors is a tuple of DDs, but both the template and the solution define and document successors as a list (list[DD]) in dd.py. This minor type/term mismatch in the description (tuple vs list) could confuse students reading the specification versus the starter code about how successors are represented and manipulated.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the representation terminology consistent. Update the problem statement to say that `successors` is a list of DDs (list[DD]) to match the code and docstrings in dd.py, or alternatively change the dd.py definitions and annotations to use tuples if you intend successors to be immutable tuples. Prefer updating the problem text to 'successors is a list of DDs' since the template/solution already use list.
